report.summary: Chunk 2 of vault.py: symlink traversal check, Vault/Page dataclasses, parse_frontmatter, _title_of.
risks: parse_frontmatter line 177 | medium | Dashed list detection uses startswith(' ') or '\t', but does not handle other indentation (e.g. non-breaking spaces). | Add a test with unusual whitespace.
_title_of line 192 | low | Returns empty string if no title, H1, or filename; caller may rely on non-empty title. | Verify all callers handle empty title.

handoff.purpose: Symlink safety, Vault/Page dataclasses, frontmatter parser, title extraction.

symbols.name: Vault
symbols.note: Dataclass with name, root, kind; to_dict method.

symbols.name: Page
symbols.note: Dataclass with rel, title, vault, frontmatter, body, body_sha256, page_type, status, updated; to_dict method.

symbols.name: _title_of
symbols.note: Extracts title from frontmatter, first H1, or filename (not shown).

claims.text: Symlink check walks the WHOLE chain: a link on any component can leave the vault, and checking only the leaf would miss `docs/link_to_etc/passwd.md`.
claims.why: The loop iterates over each segment, checking is_symlink() on the cumulative path, thus detecting symlinks at any depth.

claims.text: Deliberately a SUBSET: `key: value`, plus `key: [a, b]` and dashed lists. Nested structures are NOT parsed — they are carried verbatim as a string so nothing is silently dropped
claims.why: The parser handles only key:value, inline lists [...], and dashed lists; nested structures are not parsed (they become part of body or are skipped).

claims.text: PyYAML would also execute tags, which is a class of surprise a wiki reader must not have.
claims.why: No PyYAML usage or security analysis is present in this chunk; the claim references external behavior.

claims.text: Frontmatter title, else the first H1, else the filename. In that order, because a page's own declaration beats a heading and both beat a path.
claims.why: The function checks fm.get('title') first, then scans for '# ', and falls back to filename (not shown but implied).

observations.what: Symlink detection loops over each segment, but does not handle symlinks that are themselves symlinks (chained).
parse_frontmatter dashed list continuation only checks startswith(' ') or '\t', missing other whitespace.
_title_of may return empty string if no title, H1, or filename; caller must handle.
